avis.texte: I’ve been using this Anua niacin essence toner for a few weeks now, and the difference in my skin is amazing. It’s lightweight, absorbs quickly, and instantly leaves my skin feeling refreshed and hydrated — no stickiness or residue. The niacinamide has helped visibly even out my skin tone and reduced the appearance of redness and minor blemishes. What I love most is how it preps my skin perfectly for the rest of my routine while giving it a healthy, subtle glow. It’s gentle enough for daily use and hasn’t caused any irritation (even on my sensitive skin). If you’re looking for a toner that hydrates, soothes, and brightens, this one’s a winner.

The Anua Peach 77 Niacin Essence Toner is a light and refreshing toner. It has a very faint peach scent, not overpowering. It absorbs quickly, leaving a nice, fresh feeling. My skin felt nicely hydrated after using it. Overall, it is an excellent toner for use before serums or lotions.
Amazing ! Keeps my face cleaned and no breakouts. Switched my korean skincare from Tirtir to this korean skin care. Worth the money.

This Annui Peach 77 toner with Niacinamide, is a good toner. With brightening products such as this, I usually can tell by the next morning if they are working because I wake up looking pale in the mirror. At first I found this disconcerting, but now I think that this is just what they do sort of blanch the skin a bit. In midlife it is normal to have uneven skin tones and a sort of ruddy appearance, and this does seem to help with that a bit. It is a good underlying base for evening out my tone even better with foundation. This, I feel, is good for working in tandem with a following niacinamide serum at nighttime. It is fine as a stand-alone product though. Just apply with a gauze pad like you do most toners. One thing I was curious about, was if it would have a peach scent to it at all, because of the name and also I saw mention of fermented peaches in the making of it. It does not however smell like peaches at all, it has no scent. Which is probably healthier anyhow. This is a good toner, if you are looking to try something new and innovative!

My experience with this toner has been positive. It’s full of a lot of ingredients that my mature skin needs and that I look for in skincare products like niacinamide, vitamin c, amino acids, hyaluronic acid, and ceramides. The first thing I notice is that it feels hydrating, almost oily but definitely NOT oily, if that makes sense. It just feels good on my face and helps calm down irritation and redness that sometimes crops up. The toner is made in Korea. The box and bottle were both sealed. It expires 05/21/2027 if unopened. I did not see an expiration date if opened but the average is about 12 months. I feel like the price is fair for 8.45 fl ounces. Overall, I really like this toner. There’s a very subtle peach scent that I hardly notice so I think that almost everyone can use it. It’s a good match for my aging skin that appreciates the hydration, age-fighting, and soothing benefits it offers.
Be careful! I developed perioral dermatitis after using this product. It contains a lot of ingredients that can have a negative reaction on your skin!

Korean skincare has been a part of my routine for a long time, and I think hydrating toners may be my favorite step. This is light and a little thicker than water but not even close to a gel texture. It’s easy to apply with my fingers and a tiny bit goes a very long way. It feels very deeply hydrating but also light and dries down quickly. I think the artificial peach scent is a little heavier than I’d prefer but it’s not a bad smell just kind of overpowering. It does fade as the product dries though, so it’s short lived.

I already have the Peach Niacin serum and I like it a lot. When I saw this I decided to order it. It’s a nice, milky like toner than absorbs well. The serum and this toner help with minimizing my pores. A lot! Thank you!
